selection: highest source-train validation balanced accuracy among eight method/window pairs; exact ties prefer boxcar, matched filter, LDA, affine, then shorter window
utility_acceptance: selected final balanced preparation accuracy >=0.90; engineering feasibility only; no equality/advantage claim against the paper
